title: Delhi High Court refuses interim relief to Sonam Wangchuk, says hospitalisation not arbitrary
description: The Delhi High Court on Sunday refused to pass an interim order directing the discharge of Sonam Wangchuk from Safdarjung Hospital, holding that the government’s decision to shift him there because of his health was not arbitrary. [Gitanjali J Angmo v. Union of India & Ors].Justice Mini Pushkarna Court noted that Wangchuk was being monitored by doctors and had consented to the administration of electrolytes. Therefore, his right to bodily autonomy had not been violated, the court said.“
